mapper.sql: o.id, o.enterprise_id, o.application_id, ja.job_id AS job_id, o.title AS offer_title, o.salary_min, o.salary_max, o.currency, o.planned_start_date, o.expires_at, o.content, o.status, o.version, o.sent_at, o.created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM offers o JOIN job_applications ja ON ja.id = o.application_id WHERE o.candidate_user_id = #{candidateUserId} AND o.status <> 'DRAFT'
AND o.status = #{status}
ORDER BY o.created_at
ASC DESC , o.id
ASC DESC
